notes: OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar harvest only from registered sources; a 404 means not yet harvested, not rejection. Neither accepts single-paper submissions.
Crossref 404 is expected: Zenodo DOIs are registered with DataCite.
Google and Bing sitemap ping endpoints were retired (404 / 410); IndexNow is used.
CORE rate-limits unauthenticated requests (429); BASE serves an anti-bot page. No policy claim is made for either.
